 --> Kerala Karunya Plus KN-647 Lottery Result Today (October 29): ₹1 crore jackpot draw begins at 3 PM; here's how to check winners
 Kerala Lottery Karunya Plus KN-647 draw offers a ₹1 crore jackpot, with ticket holders awaiting winning numbers, prize details and official result verification. 
 Moneycontrol City Desk 
 October 29, 2026 / 11:53 IST Share --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 --> 
 Kerala Lottery Result today Karunya Plus KN-647 lottery draw is set for October 29, 2026.
 The first prize winner will receive ₹1 crore.
 Winners must claim their prizes within 30 days of the draw.

 The Karunya Plus KN-647 lottery draw is scheduled for Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 3 p.m. IST, with ticket holders awaiting the winning numbers and a first prize of ₹1 crore. The Kerala State Lotteries Department conducts the weekly draw, and the official results are expected to be published after the draw, typically by around 5 p.m.
 The ticket price is ₹50. The prize structure listed for KN-647 includes a second prize of ₹30 lakh, a third prize of ₹5 lakh and a consolation prize of ₹5,000 for eligible tickets from other series matching the first-prize number. Participants should check the official result list before drawing conclusions about a win, as the series and full ticket number matter.
 Karunya Plus KN-647 lottery prize structure
 The KN-647 draw has nine regular prize categories, in addition to the consolation prize. The listed prize amounts and draw details are as follows. The Directorate of Kerala State Lotteries lists the draw for 3 p.m. at Gorky Bhavan, near Bakery Junction, Thiruvananthapuram.
 Prize category Prize amount Number of winning tickets or selection 
 First prize ₹1 crore 1 winner 
 Second prize ₹30 lakh 1 winner 
 Third prize ₹5 lakh 1 winner 
 Fourth prize ₹5,000 Last 4 digits drawn 19 times 
 Fifth prize ₹2,000 Last 4 digits drawn 6 times 
 Sixth prize ₹1,000 Last 4 digits drawn 25 times 
 Seventh prize ₹500 Last 4 digits drawn 76 times 
 Eighth prize ₹200 Last 4 digits drawn 84 times 
 Ninth prize ₹100 Last 4 digits drawn 156 times 
 Consolation prize ₹5,000 Eligible tickets from other series matching the first-prize number 
 The prize amounts and winning numbers should be checked against the official result document once it is published. The numbers listed for lower prize categories refer to the specified final digits, so ticket holders should follow the rules for each category.
 How to check Kerala Lottery Karunya Plus KN-647 results
 Ticket holders can verify their numbers after the department publishes the result. The official Directorate of Kerala State Lotteries results portal provides downloadable results for completed draws.

 To check a ticket, follow these steps:
 Visit the official Kerala State Lotteries results portal.
 Find the Karunya Plus KN-647 result for October 29, 2026.
 Open the result document and check the ticket number, series and applicable prize category.
 Compare the complete ticket details with the published winning list, including the final digits where relevant.
 Keep the original ticket safe if it matches a winning entry and confirm the claim requirements with the department.
 How to claim Karunya Plus lottery prize money
 Winners should preserve their original tickets and follow the claim procedure prescribed by the Kerala State Lotteries Department. According to the claim guidance provided for the scheme, prizes must be claimed within 30 days of the draw. The required documents may include the original winning ticket, a completed claim application, identity and PAN documentation, photographs and other forms specified by the department.
 The submission process can vary depending on the prize amount. Winners should confirm the appropriate office, documentation and deadline directly with the department before submitting a claim. The official result document and applicable lottery rules will govern the final verification.
 The Karunya Plus lottery is part of Kerala’s weekly state lottery programme. Participants should rely on the department’s published results rather than unverified social media posts or preliminary number lists when checking whether their tickets have won.
